findings.statement: PMID:42473996 reports preferential CA9 enrichment in ccRCC tumour cells, an association between PET uptake and PBRM1 alterations, and imaging discrimination that requires prospective validation. This is evidence for an imaging hypothesis, not an independently validated diagnostic test or proof of tumour exclusivity across all tissues. Local univariate overall-survival analysis: [gene=CA9; type=tcga_survival; source=DATASET:TCGA-KIRC-RNA; log_hr_per_sd=-0.009] [gene=CA9; type=tcga_survival; source=DATASET:TCGA-KIRC-RNA; padj=0.9326]. The adjusted test does not establish a survival association. Frozen drug annotations: GIRENTUXIMAB (PHASE_3). Stage labels do not establish a ccRCC indication or efficacy.

PMID:38195301 reports RCC overexpression and correlation with hypoxia-pathway proteins. PMID:39510586 describes clinical associations and CD70-directed radiotracer development. Those study-level claims do not establish tumour-cell restriction in the current cohorts, where cell-attribution results conflict. Early clinical antibody programmes are not proof of efficacy. Local univariate overall-survival analysis: [gene=CD70; type=tcga_survival; source=DATASET:TCGA-KIRC-RNA; log_hr_per_sd=0.126] [gene=CD70; type=tcga_survival; source=DATASET:TCGA-KIRC-RNA; padj=0.1747]. The adjusted test does not establish a survival association. Frozen drug annotations: VORSETUZUMAB (PHASE_1); CUSATUZUMAB (PHASE_2). Stage labels do not establish a ccRCC indication or efficacy.

PMID:41399267 reports tumour enrichment and a survival association, motivating a prognostic and therapeutic hypothesis. PMID:37523719 describes inhibitors II559 and II802, including enzyme-assay selectivity and clear-cell renal cancer cell-line experiments; the earlier description as unrelated to ccRCC was incorrect. PMID:42440812 reports suppression of FN1 expression and tumour progression in experimental models. These findings remain study-specific and preclinical rather than clinical efficacy evidence. Local univariate overall-survival analysis: [gene=NNMT; type=tcga_survival; source=DATASET:TCGA-KIRC-RNA; log_hr_per_sd=0.301] [gene=NNMT; type=tcga_survival; source=DATASET:TCGA-KIRC-RNA; padj=0.0048]. This association does not establish independent prognostic utility. Measured cell-line dependency: [gene=NNMT; type=depmap_dependency; source=DATASET:DEPMAP-26Q1; mean_effect_ccrcc=0.316] [gene=NNMT; type=depmap_dependency; source=DATASET:DEPMAP-26Q1; padj=0.0725]. Selective dependency is not established under the configured rule. Computed target profile: [gene=NNMT; type=analysis_ranking; source=ANALYSIS:ranking:target:8d5ff79b77e8d233; profile=target; rank=4] [gene=NNMT; type=analysis_ranking; source=ANALYSIS:ranking:target:8d5ff79b77e8d233; profile=target; score=3.7143]. Computed biomarker profile: [gene=NNMT; type=analysis_ranking; source=ANALYSIS:ranking:biomarker:8d5ff79b77e8d233; profile=biomarker; rank=6] [gene=NNMT; type=analysis_ranking; source=ANALYSIS:ranking:biomarker:8d5ff79b77e8d233; profile=biomarker; score=4.7744]. Reported enzyme-assay affinity, in nM: [gene=NNMT; type=literature_review; source=PMID:37523719; reported_metrics.II559_Ki_nM=1.2] [gene=NNMT; type=literature_review; source=PMID:37523719; reported_metrics.II802_Ki_nM=1.6]. The reported selectivity is greater than this fold lower bound: [gene=NNMT; type=literature_review; source=PMID:37523719; reported_metrics.selectivity_fold_lower_bound=5000]. These source-reported measurements are not independent experiments performed by this project.

PMID:42028950 reports a lactate/GPR81/ERK mechanism involving macrophage polarization and T-cell function in ccRCC. This supports a mechanistic hypothesis. A negative cell-line dependency result cannot prove that any therapeutic benefit must act exclusively through the microenvironment. Measured cell-line dependency: [gene=SLC16A3; type=depmap_dependency; source=DATASET:DEPMAP-26Q1; mean_effect_ccrcc=-0.015] [gene=SLC16A3; type=depmap_dependency; source=DATASET:DEPMAP-26Q1; padj=0.9288]. Selective dependency is not established under the configured rule. Computed target profile: [gene=SLC16A3; type=analysis_ranking; source=ANALYSIS:ranking:target:8d5ff79b77e8d233; profile=target; rank=3] [gene=SLC16A3; type=analysis_ranking; source=ANALYSIS:ranking:target:8d5ff79b77e8d233; profile=target; score=3.7597].

PMID:40099255 reports experiments linking SLC6A19 to reduced invasion/proliferation and to fatty-acid-metabolism pathways. This supports a candidate tumour-suppressive mechanism in the reported experiments, not a validated clinical biomarker or an indication to inhibit the protein. Local univariate overall-survival analysis: [gene=SLC6A19; type=tcga_survival; source=DATASET:TCGA-KIRC-RNA; log_hr_per_sd=-0.456] [gene=SLC6A19; type=tcga_survival; source=DATASET:TCGA-KIRC-RNA; padj=1.07e-07]. This association does not establish independent prognostic utility. Computed biomarker profile: [gene=SLC6A19; type=analysis_ranking; source=ANALYSIS:ranking:biomarker:8d5ff79b77e8d233; profile=biomarker; rank=4] [gene=SLC6A19; type=analysis_ranking; source=ANALYSIS:ranking:biomarker:8d5ff79b77e8d233; profile=biomarker; score=5.0078].

PMID:40341002 nominates SLC2A1 among glycolysis-related biomarkers. A bioinformatic signature claim does not by itself establish diagnostic or prognostic utility in independent patients. Local univariate overall-survival analysis: [gene=SLC2A1; type=tcga_survival; source=DATASET:TCGA-KIRC-RNA; log_hr_per_sd=0.197] [gene=SLC2A1; type=tcga_survival; source=DATASET:TCGA-KIRC-RNA; padj=0.0411]. This association does not establish independent prognostic utility. TCGA tumour-versus-normal RNA: [gene=SLC2A1; type=tcga_de; source=DATASET:TCGA-KIRC-RNA; log2fc=1.8979] [gene=SLC2A1; type=tcga_de; source=DATASET:TCGA-KIRC-RNA; padj=1.98e-16].

PMID:36901940 reports IGFBP3 among genes with increased expression in ccRCC. The cited material establishes an expression observation, not therapeutic efficacy or a validated prognostic biomarker. The limited retrieved corpus does not establish absence of other published evidence. Local univariate overall-survival analysis: [gene=IGFBP3; type=tcga_survival; source=DATASET:TCGA-KIRC-RNA; log_hr_per_sd=0.047] [gene=IGFBP3; type=tcga_survival; source=DATASET:TCGA-KIRC-RNA; padj=0.6632]. The adjusted test does not establish a survival association.

PMID:39091581 studies ENO2 perturbation and includes hexokinase as a glycolysis readout. That sentence is not a direct HK2 intervention experiment and does not establish HK2 as a therapeutic target. Sparse retrieved literature is not proof that no relevant publication exists. The complete abstract of PMID:41971124 explicitly includes PSAT1 in a signature with reduced RNA and protein expression in ccRCC. Its pathway-enrichment statement concerns a different comparison and is not a contradiction of tumour-versus-normal downregulation. Functional intervention in that abstract concerns HPGD, not PSAT1. The earlier unresolved-contradiction claim is corrected. Local univariate overall-survival analysis: [gene=PSAT1; type=tcga_survival; source=DATASET:TCGA-KIRC-RNA; log_hr_per_sd=0.43] [gene=PSAT1; type=tcga_survival; source=DATASET:TCGA-KIRC-RNA; padj=5.66e-07]. This association does not establish independent prognostic utility. Computed biomarker profile: [gene=PSAT1; type=analysis_ranking; source=ANALYSIS:ranking:biomarker:8d5ff79b77e8d233; profile=biomarker; rank=1] [gene=PSAT1; type=analysis_ranking; source=ANALYSIS:ranking:biomarker:8d5ff79b77e8d233; profile=biomarker; score=5.3696].

The retained literature findings do not provide a direct experimental study for SCARB1. Its prioritisation here is data-driven; absence of a relation in this bounded corpus is not evidence of absence of relevant literature. The evidence cited here for ENPP3 prioritisation and clinical development comes from the expression and Open Targets records. The bounded literature extraction does not independently substantiate efficacy of the ADC programme. Frozen drug annotations: AGS-16C3F (PHASE_2). Stage labels do not establish a ccRCC indication or efficacy.

caveats: The bounded abstract corpus is incomplete; absence of extracted relations is not absence of literature.
An extracted sentence may need full abstract context. PSAT1 pathway enrichment was previously misread as contradictory expression evidence.
Reported preclinical and observational results do not establish clinical efficacy or independent biomarker validation.
Drug identity, profile identity and metric identity must match the actual cited record; a matching gene is insufficient.

revision.method: Reviewed saved literature-agent statements against cited local source sentences and complete abstracts, with exact bindings for local and curated reported metrics
